dialogue.t: Meow, are you here to play Genius Invokation TCG? Well, that's for me to teach you the basic rules here!
Congratulations, you've mastered the basics, meow.
Now that you've learned the rules, let's have a duel, shall we?
Oh, right! Take this Casket of Tomes. You can use it to edit your decks, meow.
Congratulations! You've become a qualified player. All the player functions are available to you now!
